description_ru: Современное звено. Аллювиальные отложения пойм (реконструкция по индексу на карте)
note: GGK-1000 new series O-(41),42 (Tyumen), Quaternary map ('Gosudarstvennaya geologicheskaya karta SSSR (novaya seriya). Karta chetvertichnykh obrazovaniy'), VSEGEI; print year NOT on the preview (no imprint, no legend); RASTER = geokniga record 44525, 2000x1706 px PREVIEW (~0.29 km/px; indices legible only in places at 4-8x zoom); frame 63-72E 56-60N, eqdc 47/62N (envelope affine rms 147-196 m; sheet cones 353-392 m); LEGEND RECONSTRUCTED from the indices printed on the map and the West-Siberian new-series conventions (descriptions are reconstructions, not transcriptions); classified on a de-symbolised base image (bright half of a 7x7 window: black dash/dot lithology symbols removed; work/pv_ws/o4142/base_img.py) with map-calibrated tints (scripts/preview_tint_calib.py, seeds at labelled points); the two backslash-hatch OVERPRINTS (6.8 px period) are detected by texture and carried as composites pk/<base> (red hatch = subaerial cover loams, coded E as on N-(44),45) and tf/<base> (green hatch = peat, O); hclass2 = base group; the faint northern peat hatch is only partly detected (O under-represented in the north); laN-Q1 (Smirnovo suite) dropped (its few unhatched patches are 4 dE from laIIsz; pixels go to the nearest la tint); shipped = O-42 part 66-72E (O-41 is O-41_pq); floodplain alluvium (cream/white dotted tint along the Tobol, Ishim, Irtysh, Tura); also takes some narrow aIII-IV strips
